description: Read one file from a repository connected to a project. A long file arrives cut and says so; generated and binary files are not read.

path.description: The file's path inside the repository, e.g. 'src/app/main.ts'. Not a URL.

reference.description: Branch, tag or commit. Omit for the default branch.

repo.description: Which repository, as 'group/repo'. Omit when only one is open.

name: read_code
